guide.name: Odisha State Scholarship Portal
guide.fullTitle: Odisha Scholarship Portal 2026: Login & Status Check
guide.seoDesc: Complete guide to the Odisha State Scholarship Portal 2026-27 (scholarship.odisha.gov.in). Learn how to check status, login, apply, and view deadlines.
guide.description: The Odisha State Scholarship Portal (OSSP) is an integrated platform by the Government of Odisha designed to bridge the gap between scholarship providers and seekers. It hosts various pre-matric, post-matric, and merit schemes including e-Medhabruti, Gopabandhu, and ST/SC Post-Matric scholarships.

loginSteps.title: Aadhaar Authentication
loginSteps.desc: Visit scholarship.odisha.gov.in and click on Registration. Enter your Aadhaar number and proceed to authenticate via OTP sent to your linked mobile number.

loginSteps.title: Receive Login Credentials
loginSteps.desc: After successful registration, your Unique User ID and Password will be sent to your registered mobile number and e-mail ID.

loginSteps.title: Student Login
loginSteps.desc: Click the login button on the portal and enter the provided User ID and password to access the scholarship application dashboard.

loginSteps.title: Select Scheme & Apply
loginSteps.desc: Choose your Department and Scheme. Fill in all required student, academic, eligibility, and bank details. You can save as a draft before final submission.

statusSteps.title: Step 1: Locate Status Section
statusSteps.desc: On the homepage of the Odisha State Scholarship Portal, find the 'Know Your Status' section.

statusSteps.title: Step 2: Enter Details
statusSteps.desc: Type in your Aadhaar number or Application No. in the text box.

statusSteps.title: Step 3: Verify with OTP
statusSteps.desc: Click on 'Get OTP', enter the password received on your mobile, and view your current application status.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.note: Mandatory for registration. Name, Gender, and DOB are fetched automatically from the Aadhaar database and cannot be edited.

documents.name: Bank Information
documents.note: Necessary details to be inputted during the application form filling for transferring the scholarship amount.

documents.name: Scheme Specific Documents
documents.note: Relevant documents asked in the site to be uploaded while filling up the online application.

faqs.q: How can I check my Odisha State Scholarship application status?
faqs.a: Use the 'Know Your Status' feature on the portal homepage. Enter your Aadhaar number or Application No., request an OTP, and check your status.

faqs.q: What happens if I detect a mistake after submitting my application?
faqs.a: Immediately inform the nodal person dealing with scholarships at your institute. The institute has a 'Revert' facility. Once they revert it, your application will become active in your login for editing and resubmission.

faqs.q: Can I log in without a mobile number linked to my Aadhaar?
faqs.a: No, Aadhaar authentication is mandatory for OSSP login. You must use a mobile number seeded to your Aadhaar to receive the OTP during registration.

faqs.q: Do I have to submit hard copies of my documents to the college?
faqs.a: It is not strictly mandatory to submit hard copies of documents to the institute on the portal level, but you can contact your concerned institute in case they require it for local verification.

faqs.q: How do I renew my scholarship on the OSSP portal?
faqs.a: Existing users can log in using their credentials and continue by selecting either 'Renewal in new course' or 'Renewal in same course' depending on their current academic status.

faqs.q: What if my institute or course is missing from the drop-down menu?
faqs.a: You should approach your institute and ask them to contact the District Welfare Officer (DWO) of the district where the institute is located to register the institution or branch in the portal.
